location.section: Art. 21 cc. 2, 4-5 (ferie)
location.quote: rispettivamente di 26 e di 30 giorni lavorativi

provenance.transformation: 28 days on a five-day week (c. 2); 26 for a worker hired for the first time in a public administration, for the first three years of service (cc. 4-5). From 1 January 2027 art. 21 of the CCNL 2025-2027 (p. 31: 'Il presente articolo entra in vigore il 1° gennaio 2027') gives 28 days to every worker: the 26-day tier ends on that day. The CCNL counts the three years in any public administration ('a qualsiasi titolo prestato' / 'presso una qualsiasi pubblica amministrazione'); the tiers read the seniority with this employer, so a worker with earlier public service gets 26 (30) days when the text gives 28 (32): state the seniority with the earlier public service included.

location.section: Art. 24 cc. 1, 10 (assenze per malattia)
location.quote: b) 90 % della retribuzione di cui alla lettera "a" per i successivi 3 mesi di assenza;

provenance.note: Job kept 18 months within the three years before the day (the CCNL sums 'le assenze per malattia verificatesi nel triennio precedente' the last episode): 540 days of 30-day months over a window of 3 years; 9 months (270 days) in full, 3 (days 271-360) at 90%, 6 (days 361-540) at 50%. The window ends on the sick day, not on the start of the last episode. The cut of the accessory pay of the first 10 days (D.L. 112/2008 art. 71 c. 1) is not modelled.

reviews.scope: Salary tables, additional months, hourly and daily divisors, overtime, leave, sickness and seniority, against the CCNLs of 12 February 2018, 9 May 2022, 27 January 2025 and 6 August 2026.
findings: Salary amounts confirmed (annual table over 12; elevate professionalità 2022: 35,000 / 13).
The first period started on 2022-05-09, the signing date; the new classification applies from 1 November 2022 (art. 18 c. 1).
The 2025-2027 values cited a union page; they are now cited to the ARAN text of 6 August 2026 (Tabella 3).
Daily quota: art. 29 c. 4 divides by 30, not 26.
Overtime is in art. 25 c. 5 of the CCNL 12.2.2018, kept in force by the CCNL 2025-2027.
Sickness: comporto of 18 months with 9 months at 100%, 3 at 90% and 6 at 50% (art. 24), not 270 days at 100%.
Leave: 26 days for the first three years of a first public employment until 31 December 2026 (art. 21 CCNL 2022-2024).
